topic: Forward-looking sonar: seeing reefs before you hit them
pipeline: v1 fallback (vidIQ credits 1 < 40): Kokoro voice + local ffmpeg compose of real Pexels footage + new PIL sonar animations

phrases: Your depth sounder only shows what's under your boat.
On a Red Sea reef, that can be too late.
Forward-looking sonar fixes that. It's like a depth sounder tipped on its side.
A transducer in the bow sends pulses of sound ahead of the boat.
They bounce off the seabed and come back. The time they take shows how far away the bottom is, and how high it rises.
Your screen draws the seabed in front of you, and an alarm sounds when it gets too shallow.
The catch? It sees further in deep water than in shallow.
One popular system sees about eight times the depth ahead.
So in three metres of water, that's only about twenty-five metres.
At ten knots, you cover that in under five seconds.
So slow down near reefs, keep a lookout, and use your charts too.
Would you fit one on your boat? Tell us in the comments.

cover_text: SEE THE REEF BEFORE YOU HIT IT
caption_en: Your depth sounder only shows what's under your boat. On a Red Sea reef, that can be too late. Forward-looking sonar sends pulses of sound ahead of the bow and draws the seabed in front of you, with an alarm when it gets too shallow. The catch: it sees less in shallow water. One popular system sees about 8x the depth ahead, so in 3 m of water that's only around 24 m. At 10 knots you cover that in under 5 seconds. Slow down near reefs, keep a lookout and use your charts too. Would you fit one on your boat? Tell us in the comments.
caption_ar: جهاز قياس العمق يُريك فقط ما تحت قاربك، وعلى شعاب البحر الأحمر قد يكون ذلك متأخرًا. السونار الأمامي يرسل نبضات صوتية أمام مقدّمة القارب ويرسم قاع البحر أمامك، وينبّهك عندما يصبح الماء ضحلًا. لكن انتبه: مداه يقلّ في المياه الضحلة؛ فأحد الأنظمة الشائعة يرى نحو ثمانية أضعاف العمق أمامه، أي حوالي ٢٤ مترًا فقط في عمق ٣ أمتار. وبسرعة ١٠ عقد تقطع هذه المسافة في أقل من ٥ ثوانٍ. لذلك خفّف السرعة قرب الشعاب، وراقب بعينك، واعتمد على الخرائط أيضًا. هل تركّب واحدًا على قاربك؟ أخبرنا في التعليقات.
